description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying {3}{G}{G}.
When Herd Baloth enters the battlefield, Black Panther triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth, as it is a Forest land due to Ashaya.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
When the Beast enters the battlefield, Black Panther triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth, as it is a Forest land due to Ashaya.
Repeat from step 3.
